scripts.text:
[Gregor]
Have you finished hunting the 50 Peco Pecos?
scripts.translation:
[格雷戈爾]
你獵殺夠50只大嘴鳥了嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: I want to quit
scripts.translation: 我想放棄

scripts.text:
[Gregor]
Hmm, I don't think you've hunted 50 yet...
scripts.translation:
[格雷戈爾]
嗯，你好像還沒獵殺夠50只...

scripts.text:
[Gregor]
Please hurry and kill 50 of those tasty err pesky Peco Pecos.
scripts.translation:
[格雷戈爾]
快去解決掉50只美味的...呃，討厭的大嘴鳥吧。

scripts.text:
[Gregor]
Are you sure that you want to stop hunting?
Any progress that you've made will be erased
scripts.translation:
[格雷戈爾]
確定要放棄狩獵嗎？
目前的任務進度都會清除。

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Gregor]
Ok then, well come back here if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[格雷戈爾]
好吧，改變主意了就回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Gregor]
Please hurry and kill 50 of those tasty err pesky Peco Pecos.
scripts.translation:
[格雷戈爾]
快去解決掉50只美味的...呃，討厭的大嘴鳥吧。

scripts.text:
[Gregor]
Oh thank you so much!
I think that I can rest easily now.
scripts.translation:
[格雷戈爾]
哦，太謝謝你了！
這下我總算能安心休息了。

scripts.text:
[Gregor]
Peco Pecos are fascinating.
I am still doing my, uh, research...
But now it is of a different nature.
scripts.translation:
[格雷戈爾]
大嘴鳥真有意思。
我還在做，呃，“研究”...不過現在研究方向變了。

scripts.text:
[Gregor]
You see I've been uh, ''researching''
these animals by collecting their
Bill of Birds but lately they seem
to have become hostile towards me.
scripts.translation:
[格雷戈爾]
我一直收集它們的鳥喙，藉此...呃，“研究”這些動物。
可是最近，它們好像開始敵視我了。

scripts.text:
[Gregor]
Can you do me a favor please?
scripts.translation:
[格雷戈爾]
能幫我個忙嗎？

scripts.text: What kind of favor?
scripts.translation: 什麼樣的忙

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Gregor]
I am so afraid that these Peco Pecos will hurt me for my, uh, researching activities.
scripts.translation:
[格雷戈爾]
我真怕這些大嘴鳥會因為我的，呃，研究活動而報復我。

scripts.text:
[Gregor]
Can you help protect me by killing them?
I think I'll feel safer...
Please...
scripts.translation:
[格雷戈爾]
能幫我殺掉它們，保護我嗎？
這樣我就能安心些...拜託了...

scripts.text: What did you need?

scripts.text:
[Gregor]
Thank you so much.
scripts.translation:

非常感謝你。

scripts.text:
[Gregor]
This is gonna be delicious!
scripts.translation:

這一定會很好吃！

scripts.text:

It doesn't look like you have enough.
scripts.translation:

看來你帶來的還不夠。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

Ah, ok I think you can help me out by hunting some Peco Pecos.
How many would you like to hunt?
scripts.translation:

好，那就幫我獵殺些大嘴鳥吧。
你打算殺多少隻？
